New tools and a smarter queue.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.1.0-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in 2.0.

**Mac (test build):** `Deviload-2.1.0-macos-test.zip`, unzip, move to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once. From 2.0.1 on, the Mac build says when a new version is out.

What's new

- Converter: drop any video or audio file and get MP4, MP3, a GIF, or a video that fits Discord, WhatsApp, mail or your own size limit
- Follow an artist: albums, EPs and singles from YouTube Music download into Artist / Album folders with track numbers and covers, new releases follow by themselves
- For Jellyfin, Emby and Plex: videos laid out as dated episodes of their channel with descriptions and posters, music by artist and album, and a library scan when the downloads finish
- Self-healing downloads: when YouTube asks to sign in, an exact stream disappears, yt-dlp needs an update or YouTube asks to slow down, Deviload fixes it once and tries again by itself
- Sleep or shut down the computer when the downloads finish, with a minute to cancel

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.0.1...v2.1.0
